anchor_scope: GitHub failure handling and the --skip-checks flag of atm-task-close.py; the dev, fix, sanity and qa templates and agent prompts
anchor_statement: atm-task-close.py must proceed with local git checks when GitHub is unreachable or rate limited, recording that in its result, and must offer a --skip-checks flag that bypasses the PR and stack checks, described only in the script's --help as requiring the phase lead's permission and named in no template or prompt.

cases.text: With gh failing on rate limit the hook records github: unavailable, checks origin/<pr_target> locally and closes; --help shows '--skip-checks: skips the PR and stack checks. Do NOT use without permission from the phase lead' and no template mentions it.
A GitHub 403 makes the hook exit with an error and the dev task cannot close, or dev-template.xml.j2 tells the dev to pass --skip-checks when gh fails.

When gh reports a rate limit or a network error, atm-task-close.py continues with local git checks against origin/<pr_target> and records github: unavailable in its JSON result. Its --help documents --skip-checks as bypassing the PR and stack checks and as needing the phase lead's permission; no template or agent prompt mentions the flag.
